Container.Name: hearth-db
Container.Overview: Postgres 16 for Hearth. Reachable only over the `hearth` docker network, by the name `hearth-db` - no host port is published, so nothing on the LAN can connect to it. Create the network first: docker network create hearth
Container.Requires: A docker network named `hearth`: docker network create hearth

Config.Name: Database directory
Config.Description: Where the database lives. Every recipe, meal plan and shopping list is in here: back it up.

Config.Name: POSTGRES_DB
Config.Description: Database name. Must match the database in the hearth container's DATABASE_URL.

Config.Name: POSTGRES_USER
Config.Description: Database user. Must match the user in the hearth container's DATABASE_URL.

Config.Name: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
Config.Description: Database password. Choose one and put the SAME value in the hearth container's DATABASE_URL. Left blank, Postgres refuses to start and says so in its log. It is only read on the very first start, when the data directory is created: changing it later edits nothing inside the database.
